card.name: Amateur radio satellite telemetry notices
card.fires_on: Words inside amateur radio news about satellite telemetry, such as baud, packet, CW, SSTV and MHz frequencies. It also fires on linking words in those sentences.

modes.label: Telemetry mode terms
modes.description: Parts of data-mode names like baud, CW, SSTV in satellite beacon announcements.
modes.example: Vietnam will send telemetry at 145.980 and 437.485 MHz using 1200-b<<aud>> packet and CW.

modes.label: Linking words in radio announcements
modes.description: Small words like using, from, or before frequencies and modes in amateur radio notices.
modes.example: The TechEdSat team is asking for assistance<< from>> amateurs in decoding and relaying data.

card.plain: It marks amateur radio satellite announcements about telemetry modes and frequencies, not anything medical.
